## Introducing Albums

Suno recently launched Albums, a way for you to turn your best music into full-length projects. Discover some of our favorite albums below.

## naenia by Oakwood///diskrot

Dive into the magic of naenia : dancing strings, melancholic vocals, and expressive percussion on songs like “My Hill” and “wildgrass” feel free and captivating. This album trails an exciting blend of classical and folk elements, drawing the listener into a wondrous world of musical chapters. My personal favorites from this album: “My Hill,” “summer, incorrectly,” and “emperor”.

## Old Soul by Isaiah Wallace

In this country album by Isaiah Wallace, Old Soul perfectly encapsulates the growing pains of getting older. Sung over warm acoustic guitar melodies, Wallace mourns nostalgic memories of evergreens, sweet tea, and late summer nights. This album is a sympathetic ode to loved ones, the feeling of being homesick, and turning a new leaf. My personal favorites from this album: “Wish Somebody Had Told Me” and “Letter to Jesus”.

## phenomenal by KakerMix///diskrot

If you’ve ever wondered what it would feel like to time travel back to the 80s, this album by KakerMix will take you there. Vintage synths, punchy electronic drums and spacey reverb make us feel like we’re entering another dimension. This album spans multiple worlds, highlighting subtle Western elements in “doin donuts///diskrot” and experimental percussion in “smashbook///diskrot”. My personal favorite from this album: “ghost money///diskrot”.

## Lost In a Dream by Dream Relic

Get lost in Dream Relic’s new album, Lost In a Dream . Following popular songs like “Seven-Eleven Halo” and “Time Is a Limited Allowance,” Lost In a Dream features a refreshing mix of down-tempo, mellow melodies and futuristic production. Songs like “Blood From a Stone” and “Raining Outside” reveal hypnotic melodies that draw the listener in. My personal favorites from this album: “Blood From a Stone,” “Raining Outside,” “!!crash!!”.

## VOID by ECHLO

Enter the VOID with ECHLO - this project is a cinematic blend of driving production, dancing piano motifs, and atmospheric vocals. Songs like “VOID” and “Desperate Inferno” feel hauntingly real and stay with us long after the melody ends. My personal favorites from this album: “VOID” and “Hold The Light”.

بعد إطلاق ميزة Albums التي تحوّل أفضل الأعمال إلى مشاريع كاملة، رشحت Suno خمسة ألبومات.

• naenia من Oakwood///diskrot: مزيج من الكلاسيكي والفولك.
• Old Soul من Isaiah Wallace: ألبوم كانتري.
• phenomenal من KakerMix///diskrot: أجواء الثمانينيات بالسينثسايزر.
• Lost In a Dream من Dream Relic: ألحان هادئة وإنتاج مستقبلي.
• VOID من ECHLO: مزيج سينمائي من البيانو والأصوات.

محتوى ترويجي يستعرض ما يمكن للمستخدمين إنجازه.
